title: iaf-reborn blackbox line
description: The flight recorder (game/terrain/terrain_view.gd _record, one file per flight: user://flights/flight-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>-m<mission>.jsonl, the newest 10 kept; the debrief screen exports the last one). JSON Lines: line 1 is the header, then rows (arrays, 10 per second) and events (objects) in time order. Frame: x east, z south (Godot), metres; angles in degrees.

flight.description: The player's flight in the mission (Settings.player_flight).

type.description: The jet's type code: 100 F-16, 110 F-15, 120 F-4E, 130 Kfir, 140 Lavi, 190 Mirage, 200 Kurnass 2000, 1000 F-35I.

jet.description: Flight-model section, e.g. "F-16" (the F-4E and the Kurnass 2000 share "F-4", as in the original).

route.description: The player's waypoints (mission world coordinates, X east, Y north).

settings.description: Every stored preference as settings.cfg holds it: sections sound / graphics / devices / gameplay / physics (bp_<id>) / keys.

columns.description: The row's column names, in order (see row).

row.description: One sample every 0.1 s of flight time.

prefixItems.description: alt_m: altitude above sea level, m.
agl_m: height of the aircraft origin above the terrain, m (null: no terrain yet). On the ground it is the gear clearance.
throttle lever, 0..1 (afterburner above the MIL detent).
ap_mode: the player's autopilot, 0 off, 1 level, 2 NAV.
ap_stage: the autopilot's control loop ("none" when off).

name.description: mission: the event's name in the mission file (bdb 0x384, e.g. "Go around").

text.description: message: a subtitle line as the mission or the radio printed it.

sink_ms.description: touchdown: the last airborne sink rate, m/s (the landing check's limit: 40 original, 4 with Physics > Real landing limits, x2 with Easy landing).

reason.description: crash: the flight model's reason (e.g. "sink rate", "tail strike").

agl_m.description: Height above the terrain at the event, m.

speed_kt.description: True airspeed at the event, kt.
